cost_model.cost_provenance: challenge-supported parameterized baseline; no empirical bid/ask/fee fields available
cost_model.spread_slippage_assumption: 5 bps per side combined execution cost

entry_convention: entry at the first raw price observation at or after signal timestamp
exit_convention: exit at the exact raw timestamp entry_timestamp + 300 seconds within the same day
position_rule: one position at a time; signals before exact exit are ignored
signal_rule: prediction > 0 LONG; prediction < 0 SHORT; prediction == 0 FLAT
